column3: BootUI uses X-BootUI-Request-Id; sharpit uses the requested X-Sharpit-Request-Id name.
Trusted-proxy peers and forwarded headers do not grant trust; the existing raw-peer guard is the sole trust test.
An unhandled exception response generated by Starlette ServerErrorMiddleware sits outside CaptureMiddleware and has no request-id header.
ASGI adds the header to a copied response-start message, following the Quarkus capture-filter shape rather than Spring's response wrapper.
The header is emitted only while the in-process HTTP exchange buffer is available so every emitted id resolves to a recorded exchange; BootUI has no buffer-availability gate.
